source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Put defineESModuleGetters for optional packaged modules under their feature flag. Packages without MOZ_UPDATER lack UpdateListener.sys.mjs. Only guarding a later call leaves an unavailable module exposed. Commit 275 moved the getter definition under AppConstants.MOZ_UPDATER, and current general.js retains it. Check builds with the feature disabled when changing these imports. This is a scoped packaging contract, not a claim about all lazy imports.
title: Gate optional-module getters on the build feature that packages them
